notes.title: Small demo patch
notes.content:
Hey there! 

We added another small patch for the demo.

Highlights:
[list]
[*] Korean, Italian, and Arabic languages are now supported, both in-game and on the steam page
[*] Translations have been slightly improved overall, both in-game, and on the steam page
[*] The hint pop-ups have been reworded to be a lot clearer in different languages
[*] A crash when you press X has been fixed
[/list]

Thanks again for all the positive and critical feedback to anyone who played the demo. We are hard at work improving the game and your input will play a big role in how the game shapes up.

Fabian & Tali

notes.title: Language Update
notes.content:
We're thrilled to see so many people playing and enjoying the demo! Watching videos of playthroughs and reading your feedback and comments has been a blast! 

And we've been listening to your requests. That's why today, we updated the demo with support for 7 additional languages, improved performance, as well as several quality of life improvements. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197711/986bed66c3a79c1733b4f7ba47946695f48d777d.png[/img]

The new languages are (in no particular order):
[list]
[*] Japanese
[*] German
[*] Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] French
[*] Spanish
[*] Chinese (simplified)
[/list]
As a small 2-person team, we don't have the resources to get the translations perfect on the first try. But we wanted to prioritise adding these languages for you as soon as possible. If you do encounter any translation errors, we've created a thread in the community hub here on Steam where you can post any translation improvements you may have!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197711/ee172bd266bbef8888a585e8e7e48b01dfb6d941.png[/img]

And as a second part to this update, we've also added several quality of life improvements, as per your feedback. These updates revolve mostly around improved performance and clearer signposting for important gameplay elements. Below is a list of the most important changes:
[list]
[*] Added Low, Medium, and High graphics quality settings
[*] Added Vsync option to the settings
[*] Unlocked the game's aspect ratio to run on all monitors, including widescreen
[*] Improved visibility of the ammo at the start of the game
[*] Improved visibility of the flashlight item pickup
[*] Improved colour balancing, so that dark areas are truly dark
[/list]

There will be further improvements to the demo and languages added, so keep your feedback coming!
